S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.description: Fails to parse/cross-reference structured data from tools, selects wrong items, misreads fields.
S1.notes: Airline: agent searches wrong flight legs, uses wrong cabin from search results, picks incorrect connecting flights. Retail: agent exchanges both items when task is to exchange only one; selects wrong product variant IDs from product details; misreads which item in an order matches the user request.

S2.label: Tool calling precision
S2.description: Right tool, wrong arguments (IDs, amounts, payment methods).
S2.notes: Airline: send_certificate with wrong amount (300 vs 50; 150 vs 50); update_reservation_flights with wrong payment_id, wrong flight number, wrong nonfree_baggages count; book_reservation with wrong passenger list or wrong payment split. Retail: exchange/modify with wrong item variant ID; cancel_pending_order with wrong reason string; modify with wrong payment method.

S3.label: Multi-step task completion
S3.description: Drops sub-tasks or wrong execution order.
S3.notes: Airline: agent updates one reservation but not all required ones (T18 needed 5 updates, did 0); cancels one flight but not the second; completes only partial passenger/baggage updates. Retail: modifies one order but misses required operations on sibling orders; modifies item but skips address change; completes one exchange but forgets the second; agent times out mid-task.

S4.label: Precondition verification
S4.description: Acts without checking conditions, caves to pressure.
S4.notes: Airline: T9 sycophancy spiral — agent loses track of task in flowery exchange (max_steps); T13 changes flight origin/destination which is disallowed (should transfer to human); T19 rebooks instead of canceling; T26/T39/T47/T49 cancel correctly but task required different action or verify-before-act step. Retail: R10 cannot cross-refund between orders but does it anyway; R12 processes refund to wrong payment method; R36/R37 cancel instead of modify pending; R82/R83 cave to pressure refunding to non-original payment method.

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
S5.notes: Airline: baggage cost calculation errors — sets nonfree_baggages=3 when 0 are chargeable; sends certificate for $300 or $150 instead of $50 (misreads policy amount); payment split arithmetic wrong in book_reservation. Retail: R46 calculates total refund wrong, misses one item from return list.

S6.label: Record discovery and retrieval
S6.description: Misses records, looks at wrong record.
S6.notes: Airline: T22 modifies wrong reservation (UM3OG5 instead of FQ8APE); T27 retrieves wrong user ID initially then never finds correct reservation; T38 never retrieves the second reservation (4OG6T3); T41 only retrieves/cancels one of 7 reservations. Retail: agent finds user but retrieves only one of several relevant orders; agent looks up one product/order and never looks at others needed for task; R54 truncates email in lookup and never finds user; R67 searches wrong last name (NoNo) and never recovers.

S7.label: Information communication
S7.description: Right action but fails to state values.
S7.notes: Airline: T11 correctly downgrades flights but fails to communicate required refund amount ($5244); T7 fails to communicate required cost difference ($1628). Retail: R19 misses communicating required price ($41.64); R24 fails to state fabric material (polyester); R45 fails to communicate price difference ($9.89); R103 fails to communicate product serial/tracking number.

S8.label: Conditional and state-aware reasoning
S8.description: Ignores if-then branches or wrong API for state.
S8.notes: Airline: T13 attempts to change origin/destination (not allowed) instead of recognizing constraint and transferring to human; T19 ignores that task requires cancel not rebook; T36 changes wrong flights without verifying change eligibility. Retail: R10/R41/R42 fail to recognize that refund-to-different-payment is not allowed and act instead of using transfer_to_human; R71 applies address change to user profile but not to pending order; R107 attempts to return a processed (non-delivered) order.
